newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Arthur Yates sprouts Mexican deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Arthur Yates sprouts Mexican deal.

text.p: Horticultural group Arthur Yates and Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had formed a joint venture with Seminis Vegetable Seeds Inc to market vegetable seeds in Australia and New Zealand.

"The new company, trading under the name Yates Vegetable Seeds Pty Ltd will have an extensive product range and depth of research making it Australasia's largest commercial vegetable seed company," Arthur Yates said.

"Effective immediately, the new business will combine the existing Australian and New Zealand businesses of Yates commercial vegetable seed and the business of New World Seeds, an Australian based company which has separately been acquired by Seminis," it said.
Eighty percent of the new entity will be owned by Yates whilst Seminis has the option of increasing its share from 20 percent to 50 percent over four years starting at the end of the first year.
Seminis currently holds about 22 percent of the world commercial vegetable seed business, Arthur Yates said.

Seminis is owned by the listed Mexican conglomerate Empresas La Moderna Sa de CV and was formed when La Moderna bought and merged three international seed and biotechnology companies -- Asgrow Seed Co and Petoseed Co, both of the U.S., and Netherlands-based Royal Sluis.
Arthur Yates' shares closed unchanged at 95 cents on Tuesday.
